tests.code: let o = OnceValue::new(); assert_eq!(o.get(), None); assert!(o.set(1)); assert!(!o.set(2)); assert_eq!(o.get(), Some(&1));

let o = OnceValue::new(); let wins = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU8::new(0); std::thread::scope(|s| { for n in 0..8 { let (o, w) = (&o, &wins); s.spawn(move || { if o.set(n) { w.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst); } }); } }); assert_eq!(wins.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1); assert!(o.get().is_some());
